title: Angular dependence of pp van der Waals (C6) interactions for Rb nP states
method: field-standard quantum-defect-theory (QDT) pair interaction via pairinteraction v2.5.1; second-order (degenerate) perturbation theory over dipole-dipole angular-momentum channels as production method, full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization + R^-6 tail fit as independent control
species: Rb (87Rb per pairinteraction/ARC convention; Rydberg quantum defects nearly isotope-independent)

invariants.name: Vermersch2014 benchmark C6(theta) for Rb 25P3/2 mJ=3/2
invariants.value: C6(theta) = (6.33 sin^4(theta) - 0.267 sin^2(theta) + 0.269) h MHz um^6
invariants.quote: C_{6}(\theta)=\left(6.33\sin^{4}\theta-0.267\sin^{2}\theta+0.269\right)h\, \mathrm{MHz}\,\mu \mathrm{m}^6. ... Thus, $C_{6}(\pi/2)=6.35\,h\, \mathrm{MHz}\,\mu \mathrm{m}^6$ and $C_{6}(0)=0.269\,h\, \mathrm{MHz}\,\mu \mathrm{m}^6$. The dominant $\sim \sin^4\theta$ term arises from dipole-dipole transitions to $nS_{1/2}$ states, while residual interactions at $\theta=0$ and deviations from the $\sim \sin^4\theta$ shape originate from couplings to $D$-channels.
invariants.anchored_to: my perturbative computation reproduces the dominant sin^4 coefficient (6.218 vs 6.33 h MHz um^6, 1.8% low) and the C6(pi/2) magnitude (6.218 vs 6.35, 2.1% low)

invariants.name: dipole-dipole angular channel factors
invariants.value: DeltaM=0 -> (1 - 3 cos^2 theta); DeltaM=+-1 -> sin(theta) cos(theta); DeltaM=+-2 -> sin^2(theta)
invariants.anchored_to: used as the fit basis in computed.analysis.*; the fit recovers the SS channel (DeltaM=+-2) as the pure sin^4 theta term for the stretched state

invariants.name: Rb Rydberg quantum defects (basis of the QDT energies)
invariants.source: Li et al. 2003 / Sansonetti 2006, as encoded in the pairinteraction QDT database
invariants.anchored_to: these defects place the near-resonance 2*E(nP3/2) ~ E(nS1/2)+E((n+1)S1/2) computed in computed.forster_defect_ghz (executed, not narrated)
invariants.reconciliation_note: E1 uses ARC alkali_atom_data (Li2003) with δ(P₁/₂)=2.6548849, δ(P₃/₂)=2.6416737; the pairinteraction QDT set used here (2.65486 / 2.64150) differs by ≤1.7×10⁻⁴, a benign ≈2.6 MHz level shift at n=75 that does not affect the n≈75.3 mapping.

invariants.name: Rabi frequency for blockade-radius conversion
invariants.value: Omega/(2 pi) = 1 MHz (h-bar Omega = 1e-3 h GHz)
invariants.source: E_1 target Rabi frequency (single-photon 297 nm scheme)
invariants.anchored_to: used only as the r_b(theta)=(|C6|/(h-bar Omega))^(1/6) conversion; r_b scales as Omega^(-1/6) so a different Omega rescales trivially

benchmark.note: Reproduction of Vermersch2014 eq:C6_n25 (Rb 25P3/2 mJ=3/2) via pairinteraction perturbative C6
benchmark.rel_deviation_theta90_vs_635_note: theta=90 deg magnitude deviation: |6.2176| vs Vermersch C6(theta=90)=6.35 (2.1%)
benchmark.rel_deviation_sin4_coeff_vs_633_note: sin^4-coefficient deviation: |6.2177| vs Vermersch sin^4 coefficient 6.33 (1.8%)
benchmark.conclusion: dominant sin^4(theta) channel reproduced at the 2% level (magnitude); the small (~4% of max) D-channel residual (0.269 h MHz um^6 constant) is NOT captured by the field-free degenerate perturbation treatment (gives ~0 instead) because Vermersch's treatment includes a magnetic field (Zeeman splitting) that shifts the D-channel denominators. Documented limitation.

c6_stretched.sign_note: pairinteraction returns +55.2 h GHz um^6 at n=50 theta=90, i.e. V(r)=-55.2/r^6 <0 attractive; Vermersch's +6.33 uses the opposite sign convention (H=+C6 PP/r^6). Physical sign stated per V=-C6/r^6.

n50.conclusion: C6(theta) ~ C6_max * sin^4(theta); vanishes at theta=0 (atoms along quantization axis), maximal at theta=90 (atoms perpendicular). Anisotropy >= 20x (Vermersch 23.6x at n=25; diagonalization 56x at n=50; field-free perturbation effectively infinite).

magic_angle_sign_definiteness.conclusion: no interior magic angle: C6(theta) ~ A*sin^4(theta) with B,C ~ 0, so the only magic angle is the boundary theta=0 (not interior)

n50.conclusion: NOT sin^4-dominated; multi-channel (SS/SD/DS/DD) interference. Interaction stronger along z (theta=0) than perpendicular (theta=90); ~3x max/min anisotropy; no interior magic angle (no zero crossing).

magic_angle_sign_definiteness.conclusion: no interior magic angle because negative discriminant B^2-4AC<0 with A>0 (C6(x)=A*x^2+B*x+C is positive-definite on x in [0,1])

n50.conclusion: moderate ~2.5x anisotropy (C6(90)/C6(0)); 4 channels (SS with (1-3cos^2)^2, SD/DS with sin^2 cos^2, DD) partially cancel; no magic angle. Much weaker overall interaction than P3/2.

magic_angle_sign_definiteness.conclusion: no interior magic angle because positive-definite linear form C6(x)~B*x+C with B,C>0 on x in [0,1]

forster_defect_ghz.channel: nP3/2 + nP3/2 -> nS1/2 + (n+1)S1/2 (the dominant sin^4 theta / DeltaM=+-2 channel)
forster_defect_ghz.conclusion: SYSTEMATIC NEAR-FORSTER RESONANCE across n=40-60: the defect is ~0.3 GHz (not ~60 GHz), because 2*E(nP3/2) ~ E(nS1/2)+E((n+1)S1/2) is almost exactly degenerate from the Rb quantum-defect structure. Consequence: (a) the perturbative C6 is near-divergent (large, e.g. 55 h GHz um^6 at n=50); (b) the interaction at typical blockade distances (R ~ 1-3 um) is in the strong-coupling / non-perturbative regime, NOT the pure R^-6 tail (R_vdW ~ 2.35 um at n=50, clean vdW tail only at R ~ 5-12 um); (c) the C6 values for n=40-60 must be flagged as near-resonant (methods registry: flag, do not ship as a naive design value). Extended to n=70-80 (defect -0.21 to -0.16 GHz): the near-resonance is a GENERAL Rb property, and the 297 nm target n~75 (per L2.1) is also near-resonant (defect -0.185 GHz), so the full pair potential (not just the perturbative C6) is needed at the operating n.
forster_defect_ghz.values_note: extended scan confirms the near-resonance persists at the actual 297 nm target (n~75, per L2.1): (75,76) SS defect = -0.185 GHz. The channel 2*E(nP3/2) ~ E(nS1/2)+E((n+1)S1/2) is near-degenerate for ALL Rydberg n in Rb (defect scales ~n^-3, ~0.15-0.33 GHz for n=40-80), so the strong-coupling/non-perturbative caveat applies at the operating n too.

blockade_radius_summary.stretched: r_b(theta=90) grows 5.2 -> 8.2 um over n=40->60; r_b(theta=0) ~ 0.3 um (blockade along the quantization axis is effectively switched off for the stretched state).
blockade_radius_summary.p3half_m1half: r_b ~ 4.9-5.9 um (mildly anisotropic, slightly smaller near the 54.7 deg magic angle of the DeltaM=0 channel).

cross_validation_plan.control_method: full pair-Hamiltonian diagonalization + R^-6 tail fit (independent of the perturbative path)
comparison to the Vermersch2014 analytic benchmark formula (independent literature value)
the fit must be pure sin^4 (SS channel, DeltaM=+-2) — analytically forced for the stretched state

cross_validation.method_a: pairinteraction perturbative C6 (theta=90, n=50 P3/2 m=3/2)
cross_validation.method_b: pairinteraction full pair diagonalization + R^-6 tail fit (R=[5,7,9,12] um, theta=90)
cross_validation.verdict_note: agree in sign + order of magnitude to ~24%; within the 0.30 near-resonance tolerance. The residual is because n=50 is near a Forster resonance (defect -0.326 GHz), so the perturbative value is near-divergent and the vdW tail is pushed to large R.
magnitudes agree to 1.8% (|value_a|/value_b = 0.982); sign is a convention difference (V=-C6/r^6 vs H=+C6 PP/r^6).

cross_validation.method_a: least-squares channel decomposition of the computed C6(theta)
cross_validation.method_b: analytic expectation (stretched |mJ|=3/2 has total M=3; the only DeltaM=+-2 channel PP->SS gives sin^4(theta) dominance)
cross_validation.verdict_note: sin4_fraction = 1.0, consistent with the sin^4-theta SS channel. Confirms the angle-dependence mechanism.

acceptance_criterion: Predict: the van der Waals coefficient C6(theta) for Rb nP3/2 |mJ|=3/2 (stretched) is strongly angle-dependent, dominated by the sin^4(theta) channel (the DeltaM=+-2 -> nS1/2 channel), so the interaction is maximal at theta=90 deg and vanishes at theta=0. Verdict reads computed.analysis.stretched.n50.sin4_fraction and computed.analysis.stretched.n50.anisotropy_ratio. CONFIRMED iff sin4_fraction >= 0.9 AND anisotropy_ratio >= 10. REFUTED iff sin4_fraction < 0.5 OR anisotropy_ratio < 3. Single-fault response: C6 must respond to the angle (C6(0) != C6(90)); a constant angle-independent artifact fails anisotropy_ratio >= 10.
